title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataProductDescription
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataProductDescription. The full description of the Data Product service offering.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataProductDescription'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

dataSets.description: Property. Description of the data sets provided by the Data Product, using DCAT-3 form.

dataProductConfigurationParameters.description: Relationship. The parameters enabling definition of the scope/extent of the service instance. Links to one or more DataProductConfigurationParameter entities.

dataLicense.description: Relationship. List of data access and data usage constraints defined by the data Rights Holder. Links to a DataLicense entity.
